scope: Inert metadata-only owner-card boundary and capacity decision for owner approval

card_shape_preserved_for_planning.serialization: Compact sorted UTF-8 JSON with ASCII escapes, finite values and exactly one LF

metadata_boundary_proposed.future_form: A pure inspection function in a separately approved counted source module; no CLI or coordinator in this increment
metadata_boundary_proposed.inputs: Bounded owner-card bytes plus a fixed, already retained controller source context. No arbitrary protocol paths, commands, callbacks, providers or network resolvers.
required_checks: Reject invalid UTF-8, unknown or missing keys at every closed depth, duplicate JSON keys, NaN/Infinity and finite-number overflow such as 1e999
Enforce exact scalar and container types; booleans cannot substitute for integer counts and integers cannot substitute for booleans
Reject encoded string overflow, empty accountable-human/statement values, placeholder or zero identities, wrong schema and wrong operative record kind; never truncate or silently normalize
Require declared approval true and serial one-shot scope, no retry/resume, 300 seconds and 24576 log bytes per worker, fixed worker order, four 16384-byte environment slots
Resolve exact retained raw and canonical v2 protocol identities, source membership/index identity and runtime-manifest plus both lock hashes before any data access

Expand the protocol bindings for candidate, wheel, input metadata, profile, numerical criteria and all caps, and the manifest bindings for CPython/NumPy/packages/runtime distributions into owner-readable facts
Preserve controller versus candidate identity; reject same-version wheel substitution, stale source contexts, unsupported protocol selection and manifest/lock mismatch

Check controller-native literal absolute root and trusted parent without creating or reserving them; refuse traversal, alternate streams, links/reparse points, foreign path flavor and observed reuse. Do not reinterpret paths across platforms. These read-only observations are not an atomic root claim.
Return only bounded authored metadata or a bounded authored refusal; never expose card text or raw exception text through a refusal

successful_result_contract.scope: Declared metadata match only; no proof of the human's identity, platform attestation, physical validation or independent scientific review

proposed_result_storage.serialization: Compact sorted UTF-8 JSON with ASCII escapes and one LF; no result truncation
proposed_result_storage.maximum_model: Card plus complete frozen protocol metadata and runtime distribution, lock and package name/version/artifact identities; full retained records remain separately inspectable by exact hashes

metadata_boundary_proposed.fixtures_and_false_authority: The metadata-only increment must not introduce an operative test-mode bypass. Existing non-authorizing fixtures and false authority still refuse the operative-card contract. Future positive tests must establish synthetic identity contexts without producing a usable real-data approval card or granting execution authority.
forbidden_effects: Import QS-DMSS or NumPy for numerical work

reuse_decisions.read_regular_and_literal: Reuse only through their complete counted frozen source; bounded metadata/path reads do not establish data or execution admission
reuse_decisions.StoreV2: Retain the qualified immutable instance-local ledger for a future coordinator; this metadata-only boundary does not instantiate it
reuse_decisions.runtime_manifest_and_locks: Reuse exact retained metadata identities; do not equate metadata resolution with admit_environment's installed-member checks
reuse_decisions.checked_protocol_v1: Not a strict general card parser and not a v2 selector. Its frozen pin, numeric semantics and globals must remain unchanged.
reuse_decisions.historical_design_or_prototype_files: Read-only references for this analysis only. No future validator/test/operative guide may load them without full byte/index accounting and separate admission. The older 9872-byte draft is not qualified code.

remaining_future_execution_gates: Owner approves a feasible capacity/source contract and separately authorizes implementation
Complete actual readable validator/tests/guide/index closure fits all planning targets and source cap with at least 4096 spare
Independent review of exact future controller/source identities and before/after installed runtime members
Separate coordinator admission proving atomic output-root claim, immutable v2 budgets throughout all calls, serial one-shot supervision and v1 compatibility
Measured peak transport/publication/failure/control schemas, 33rd triggering counterexample retention, and complete integrity inventory with own encoded size counted
New locked synthetic qualification and protected remote review for any newly admitted component
Final separately inspected owner card and explicit one-shot real-data execution authorization
